body:
Good afternoon,

Thank you for applying to Fall Software Development Engineer Internship - 2026 (US) position (Job ID: 3116030). We would like to invite you to complete the first step in our recruiting process; the online assessment (OA)!

Below is some key information about our fall internship program:
- Start dates: August/September
- Duration: 12 weeks
- Schedule: Full-time, in-office, Monday–Friday, up to 40 hours per week (typically 8am–5pm)
- Academic requirement: Applicants must have a minimum of one quarter/semester/trimester remaining in their studies after the potential internship concludes

Now what?: If you are interested in and eligible for a fall internship, you can expect an invitation from noreply@mail.amazon.jobs titled “SDE-I Intern Online Assessment Invitation” which contains detailed instructions, preparation materials and a link for the OA. Please be sure to check your spam/junk mail folder for the delivery of the email if it does not appear in your email inbox. If you have not received the invitation for the OA in your inbox within 24 hours of receiving this email, please reply and provide an alternate email address.

What to expect: The SDE Intern online assessment includes multiple parts that consist of a coding and workstyle portion. You must complete all parts of the OA in order for our team to review your results – failure to complete all parts by the deadline will results an incomplete assessment and a withdrawal of your application.

Accommodation Request: Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We not only celebrate the diversity of our workforce; we celebrate the diverse ways we work. If you have a disability and need an accommodation, please reach out to our team or click on this link for more information.

Note: If you are not available or eligible for a fall internship, please withdraw your application via amazon.jobs.

Best of luck!
Amazon University Talent Acquisition

Jackie
Recruiter
Amazon University Talent Acquisition (AUTA)
sp-sde-intern-assessment@amazon.com

Frequently Asked Questions

What location am I being considered for?
Your application will be considered for all US locations. The majority of our fall roles are concentrated at our headquarters in Seattle, WA and Arlington, VA with additional openings in: Austin/Dallas, TX, the Bay Area, CA, Boston Metro, NYC Metro, Denver / Boulder, CO and Portland, OR. We will take your location preferences into consideration; however, placement is based on business availability and is not guaranteed.

What are the Amazon internship work expectations?
Amazon internships are in-person, Monday-Friday, up to 40 hours per week typically between 8am-5pm. If you receive an offer, your manager will communicate specific team norms around working hours based on business needs. Interns should not have conflicts such as classes or other employment during the Amazon workday. Any inability to work during business hours may affect your internship.

If my graduation date changes, does that impact my application?
Yes. If your graduation date changes to a date before 12/1/2026, you may be eligible for a full-time position. Please email your Amazon University Talent Acquisition recruiting point of contact as soon as possible if you anticipate any changes that could affect your eligibility.
